_readme: The protocol picks a capability profile per task; this file maps profiles to concrete local models.
Each profile names one model per tool: claudeModel for Claude Code, codexModel for Codex (since v3.10.0).
Shipped default: every value is 'inherit', so installing changes nothing about which model runs.
While every value is 'inherit', routing is INERT - 'handoff.ps1 models' and 'doctor' say so.
To activate without editing this file, set HANDOFF_CLAUDE_MODEL_<PROFILE> or HANDOFF_CODEX_MODEL_<PROFILE> in your environment.
Or replace 'inherit' with a model name the tool accepts, for example:
cheap_readonly -> a small fast model, used for read-only investigation turns
economy        -> a small fast model, used for low-risk work
high_reasoning -> your strongest model; concrete escalation also requires -AllowModelEscalation
Automated Codex turns (master-run, review-run, the Codex Implementer) pass codexModel as --model; NEXT_TURN.md names it for window turns.
Model names are intentionally NOT shipped here: they change often and belong to your setup, not the protocol.
